title: Qwen3-TTS: Advanced Zero-Shot Speech Synthesis
summary: A specialized text-to-speech suite from Alibaba Qwen supporting zero-shot voice cloning from 3-second samples and natural language voice design. It utilizes a Dual-Track hybrid streaming architecture to achieve ultra-low latency and high-quality prosody across 10 languages.
research_notes: Released under Apache 2.0 license; features voice design via text prompts and sub-100ms first-packet latency for real-time applications.

evolution.summary: Qwen3-TTS marks a shift from general audio-understanding models like Qwen2-Audio to a dedicated generation suite. It includes 0.6B and 1.7B variants, introducing the Qwen3-TTS-Tokenizer-12Hz for superior compression and emotional range.
